I can't calculate embedded emissions for this shipment because CN code 7202 11 (ferro-manganese, >2% carbon) is not in the factor table. Under the ruleset, a good must be in the table to produce an estimate, so I have not estimated a figure.

The table covers only these CN codes:
- 7201 (pig iron and spiegeleisen)
- 7206 10 00 (ingots of iron and non-alloy steel)
- 7207 11 90 (semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel)
- 7214 20 00 (bars and rods with indentations)

The quantity (500 t) and country (China) are provided, but they cannot be used without a matching default SEE for CN 7202 11 and China.

To proceed, you would need to supply a default SEE value for CN 7202 11 produced in China from an authorised source, or confirm whether a different CN code applies to the good. Once a table entry exists, the calculation is 500 t × the China SEE for that code, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
